sections.shortTitle: Larkana and the Sehwan Sevelopment Authorities Rrevival and Amending Ordinance 2007
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIII OF 2007
ORDINANCE XIII OF
2007
LARKANA AND THE
SEHWAN DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITIES (REVIVAL
AND AMENDING)
ORDINANCE, 2007
An Ordinance to revive
and amend the laws relating
to Larkana and Sehwan Development Authorities
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,
24th July, 2007]
No.S.Legis:1(13)/2007, dated 24-7-2007.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:-
Preamble.---Whereas in order to give impetus and encourage the
housing industry and provide shelter to the people of the Province, it is
expedient to revive and amend the Larkana Development
Authority Act 1994 and the Sehwan Development
Authority Act,1993;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor of Sindh is satisfied
that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now,
therefore, in exercise
of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of
Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the
Governor of Sindh is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance: -
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Larkana and the Sehwan
Development Authorities (Revival and Amending) Ordinance, 2007.
(2) It shall come into force at once and
shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from 1st May, 2007.

3. Saving.---All orders made,
proceedings taken, appointments made, acts done by any authority, or by any
person, which were made, taken or done, or purported to have been made, taken
or done between the first day of July, two thousand two, and the date on which
this Ordinance comes into force (both days inclusive), shall notwithstanding
any judgment of any court be deemed to be and always to have been validity
made, taken or done under the said laws and shall not be called in question in
